papers.title: Reproducible Biochemical Modes Within a Structured Neurochemical Continuum in Autism Spectrum Disorder Revealed by NeuroCLAD
papers.translated_title: NeuroCLAD揭示的自闭症谱系障碍中结构化神经化学连续体内的可重复生化模式
papers.author: Sharma, A.
papers.summary: Abstract Background Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) is biologically heterogeneous, yet most neurochemical studies rely on single-analyte comparisons that cannot capture coordinated variation across neurotransmitter systems. Whether peripheral neurochemical variation in ASD is best represented by discrete biochemical subtypes or continuous multivariate organisation remains unresolved. Methods We developed and applied NeuroCLAD, a structured multivariate analytical framework, to peripheral blood neurotransmitter profiles from 261 children with ASD (mean age 6.98 (SD 3.13) years; 78.5% male). The pipeline combined age- and sex-adjusted multivariate profiling with principal component analysis, consensus k-means clustering with null-model validation, BIC-guided Gaussian mixture modelling, enrichment analysis, and clinical symptom mapping. Cross-compartment consistency was explored using urine neurotransmitter profiles from the same cohort. Results Twelve reproducible biochemical clusters were identified, each characterised by distinct multi-analyte neurochemical fingerprints involving trace amines, monoamines, catecholamine metabolism, histamine, and amino-acid neurotransmitter systems. Stability was confirmed across 200 bootstrap iterations and exceeded that expected under matched isotropic and covariance-preserving Gaussian null models. Bayesian Information Criterion guided Gaussian mixture model enumeration identified an optimal two-component solution comprising one dominant mixture component (n=222) and one smaller component characterized by elevated phenethylamine (PEA) and tyrosine (n=39). Behavioral mapping revealed graded symptom tendencies, particularly for aggressiveness, self-injurious behaviour, and picky eating. Formal symptom-cluster associations were non-significant after multiple-testing correction, consistent with graded rather than categorical relationships between peripheral neurochemistry and behavioural phenotype. Limitations Peripheral blood provides an indirect, analyte-dependent representation of neurochemical biology. The cross-sectional design, absence of a neurotypical comparison group, modest cluster sizes, and lack of external validation limit clinical interpretation. Conclusions Peripheral neurochemistry in ASD is organised into reproducible biochemical modes within a continuous multivariate landscape rather than discrete biochemical subtypes. This dimensional framework may better represent biological heterogeneity and provides a basis for future pathway-informed stratification and treatment-response studies.
papers.translated_summary: 摘要 背景 自闭症谱系障碍（ASD）具有生物学异质性，但多数神经化学研究依赖单一分析物比较，无法捕捉神经递质系统间的协调变异。ASD外周神经化学变异究竟以离散的生化亚型还是连续的多变量组织模式为最佳表征，这一问题尚未解决。 方法 我们开发并应用了结构化多变量分析框架NeuroCLAD，对261名ASD儿童（平均年龄6.98岁，标准差3.13；男性占78.5%）的外周血神经递质谱进行分析。该流程结合了年龄与性别校正的多变量谱分析、主成分分析、基于零模型验证的共识k均值聚类、BIC引导的高斯混合模型、富集分析及临床症状映射。通过同一队列的尿液神经递质谱探索跨区室一致性。 结果 识别出12个可重复的生化聚类，每个聚类具有独特的多种分析物神经化学指纹，涉及痕量胺、单胺类、儿茶酚胺代谢、组胺及氨基酸神经递质系统。稳定性经200次bootstrap迭代验证，且超过匹配各向同性和协方差保持高斯零模型下的预期值。贝叶斯信息准则引导的高斯混合模型枚举确定了最优双组分解，包含一个主要混合组分（n=222）和一个以苯乙胺（PEA）和酪氨酸升高为特征的小组分（n=39）。行为映射显示分级症状倾向，尤其在攻击性、自伤行为和挑食方面。经多重检验校正后，症状-聚类关联未达显著性，这与外周神经化学与行为表型之间呈分级而非分类关系一致。 局限性 外周血提供的是间接且依赖分析物的神经化学生物学表征。横断面设计、缺乏神经典型对照组、聚类规模较小及缺乏外部验证限制了临床解读。 结论 ASD的外周神经化学在连续多变量景观中组织为可重复的生化模式，而非离散的生化亚型。这一维度框架可能更好地表征生物学异质性，并为未来基于通路的患者分层及治疗反应研究提供基础。

papers.title: Keyphrase Identification Using Minimal Labeled Data with Hierarchical Contexts and Transfer Learning
papers.translated_title: 使用分层上下文和迁移学习的最小标注数据关键词识别
papers.author: Goli, R.
papers.summary: Background: Interoperable clinical decision support system (CDSS) rules provide a pathway to interoperability, a well-recognized challenge in health information technology. Building an ontology facilitates creating interoperable CDSS rules, and identifying the keyphrases (KP) from the existing literature can be a first step for building an ontology. Ontology construction requires curation by human domain experts (HDE) traditionally, and modern natural language processing (NLP) techniques can be a critical complementary component nevertheless requires human proficiency, consensus, and contextual understanding for data labeling. Methods: We present a semi-supervised KP identification framework using a hierarchical-attention BiLSTM-CRF (Hier-Attn-BiLSTM-CRF) with word-, sentence-, and document-level attention. A domain-adapted sciSpacy model was used to generate synthetic labels for bootstrap training, followed by fine-tuning with minimal HDE-labeled data. We then evaluated robustness through component ablation, comparison with fine-tuned biomedical transformers (BioBERT, SciBERT, PubMedBERT) with bootstrap confidence intervals, train-split sensitivity, multi-seed variance analysis, error analysis, and benchmarking against public corpora (KPBioMed, PubMedAKE). Results: The Hier-Attn-BiLSTM-CRF is competitive with fine-tuned transformer baselines on the HDE labeled dataset (GS42: ~44 vs. ~46 F1; GS91: 61.3 vs. ~54 F1), through an explicit hierarchical inductive bias over word-, sentence-, and document-level representations, complementing the implicit contextual modeling of the transformer. Controlled ablation identifies gold-standard fine-tuning as the dominant performance lever. Mixing HDE and synthetic labels in 2:100-4:100 ratios improved performance without exhausting the human-labeled set too quickly. Models trained on sparser public corpora transferred poorly to CDSS across all architectures, underscoring the value of in-domain synthetic labels. Conclusions: This feasibility study demonstrates a practical, resource-efficient framework for CDSS KP identification under limited HDE annotation. The contribution lies in integrating established components: domain-adapted synthetic labels, hierarchical attention, and minimal gold-standard fine-tuning, for the CDSS sub-domain. A full downstream evaluation of the role of the NLP pipeline for CDSS ontology construction is the primary next step.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：可互操作的临床决策支持系统（CDSS）规则为实现互操作性提供了途径，而互操作性是健康信息技术领域公认的挑战。构建本体有助于创建可互操作的CDSS规则，从现有文献中识别关键短语（KP）可作为构建本体的第一步。传统上，本体构建需要人类领域专家（HDE）进行人工筛选，现代自然语言处理（NLP）技术可作为关键补充组件，但仍需人类在数据标注中具备专业能力、共识和上下文理解能力。方法：我们提出了一种半监督KP识别框架，采用层级注意力BiLSTM-CRF（Hier-Attn-BiLSTM-CRF），结合词级、句级和文档级注意力机制。使用领域适配的sciSpacy模型生成合成标签用于引导训练，随后通过少量HDE标注数据进行微调。我们通过组件消融实验、与微调生物医学Transformer模型（BioBERT、SciBERT、PubMedBERT）的对比（含自助法置信区间）、训练集划分敏感性分析、多随机种子方差分析、错误分析以及在公共语料库（KPBioMed、PubMedAKE）上的基准测试来评估鲁棒性。结果：Hier-Attn-BiLSTM-CRF在HDE标注数据集上与微调Transformer基线模型表现相当（GS42：~44 vs. ~46 F1；GS91：61.3 vs. ~54 F1），其通过词级、句级和文档级表示的显式层级归纳偏置，补充了Transformer的隐式上下文建模。控制消融实验表明，金标准微调是性能提升的主导因素。将HDE标签与合成标签以2:100-4:100比例混合，可在不过快消耗人工标注数据的情况下提升性能。基于稀疏公共语料库训练的模型在所有架构上对CDSS的迁移效果均较差，凸显了领域内合成标签的价值。结论：本可行性研究展示了在HDE标注有限条件下，一种实用且资源高效的CDSS KP识别框架。其贡献在于整合了成熟组件：领域适配的合成标签、层级注意力机制和最小化金标准微调，专用于CDSS子领域。下一步主要工作是开展NLP流水线在CDSS本体构建中作用的完整下游评估。

papers.title: Multilevel Factors Associated with Nonresponse to Patient-Reported Outcome Measures in Routine Radiation Oncology Care
papers.translated_title: 与常规放射肿瘤学护理中患者报告结局测量无应答相关的多层次因素
papers.author: Liu, J. B.
papers.summary: PurposeNonresponse to routinely collected patient-reported outcome measures (PROMs) threatens the representativeness of aggregated data. We characterized patient-, provider-, and clinic-level factors associated with PROMIS Global-10 nonresponse in routine radiation oncology care. MethodsIn this retrospective cohort study, all adults seen at five Mass General Brigham radiation oncology clinics over one year were included. The primary outcome was patient-level nonresponse, defined as never completing the portal-administered Global-10 versus completing it at least once. Using iterative mixed-effects logistic regression, we modeled patient-, provider-, and clinic-level factors. ResultsAmong 12,214 patients, 71 providers, and five clinics, patient- and appointment-level response rates were 35.4% and 10.9%, with patient-level response ranging nearly fivefold across clinics (12.8% to 66.2%). In Model 1, male sex, lower education, not working, and recent surgery had higher odds of nonresponse, and longer time since diagnosis lower odds. After provider- and clinic-level factors were added, patient sex, education, and employment became nonsignificant, whereas recent surgery (adjusted odds ratio [aOR] 1.97) and longer time since diagnosis (aOR 0.46 for >12 months) persisted. A providers historical collection rate was protective but attenuated at the clinic level. There, a later program launch (aOR 0.29) and higher historical collection rate (aOR 0.79) correlated with lower nonresponse, whereas academic versus community setting did not. ConclusionsNonresponse to routinely collected PROMs is a multilevel phenomenon driven substantially by clinic-level implementation factors, not patient characteristics alone. Because response rate is only a proxy for representativeness, PROMs programs and PRO-based performance measures should prioritize representative collection over volume.
papers.translated_summary: 目的：常规收集的患者报告结局测量工具（PROMs）应答缺失会威胁汇总数据的代表性。本研究旨在分析常规放疗护理中与PROMIS Global-10应答缺失相关的患者、医生及诊所层面因素。方法：这项回顾性队列研究纳入一年内就诊于麻省总医院布莱根分院五家放疗诊所的所有成年患者。主要结局为患者层面应答缺失，定义为从未完成门户网站管理的Global-10问卷（相较于至少完成一次者）。采用迭代混合效应逻辑回归模型分析患者、医生及诊所层面因素。结果：在12,214名患者、71名医生及五家诊所中，患者层面和就诊层面应答率分别为35.4%和10.9%，各诊所患者层面应答率差异近五倍（12.8%至66.2%）。模型1显示，男性、低教育水平、无业及近期手术史患者的应答缺失风险更高，而确诊时间越长则风险越低。加入医生及诊所层面因素后，患者性别、教育水平及就业状态的影响不再显著，但近期手术史（校正比值比[aOR] 1.97）和确诊时间较长（>12个月aOR 0.46）仍具显著性。医生历史收集率具有保护作用，但在诊所层面效应减弱。在诊所层面，项目启动时间较晚（aOR 0.29）和较高历史收集率（aOR 0.79）与较低应答缺失相关，而学术型与社区型诊所设置无显著差异。结论：常规收集PROMs的应答缺失是多层面现象，主要受诊所层面实施因素驱动，而非单纯患者特征所致。由于应答率仅是代表性的替代指标，PROMs项目及基于PRO的绩效评估应优先考虑代表性收集而非数量。

papers.title: Afterload-Adjusted Strain Refines Risk Stratification in Aortic Stenosis With Varying Degrees of Aortic Regurgitation
papers.translated_title: 后负荷调整应变优化了不同程度主动脉瓣反流合并主动脉瓣狭窄的风险分层
papers.author: Sun, J.
papers.summary: Background and Objectives: In aortic stenosis (AS), concomitant aortic regurgitation (AR) may cause heterogeneous left ventricular (LV) remodeling and myocardial responses beyond valve-centric assessment. We evaluated LV geometry and myocardial deformation relative to systolic pressure load in patients with AS across varying AR severity. Methods: We analyzed 950 patients with moderate or greater AS categorized as no AR, mild AR, or moderate or greater AR. LV geometry was assessed using LV mass index (LVMI) and relative wall thickness (RWT). Afterload-adjusted strain (AAS) was calculated as absolute LV global longitudinal strain (LVGLS) multiplied by estimated LV systolic pressure. The primary outcome was all-cause death or heart failure hospitalization. Results: During a median follow-up of 3.5 years, 122 primary events occurred. Increasing AR severity was associated with LV dilation, increased LVMI, and reduced RWT, whereas AAS remained similar across AR categories. LV geometric measures were not independently associated with the primary outcome. Lower AAS was independently associated with the primary outcome (adjusted HR 1.33 per 500-unit decrease, 95% CI 1.12-1.58; p=0.001; adjusted HR 1.41 per 1-SD decrease, 95% CI 1.14-1.73; p=0.001). AAS provided incremental prognostic value beyond clinical and LV geometric variables, increasing the 1-year AUC from 0.762 to 0.788 (p<0.001). Conclusions: Among patients with moderate or greater AS across varying degrees of concomitant AR, increasing AR severity was associated with progressive LV remodeling, whereas lower AAS was independently associated with adverse outcomes. Relating myocardial deformation to systolic pressure load may refine risk stratification beyond clinical and LV geometric measures.
papers.translated_summary: 背景与目的：在主动脉瓣狭窄（AS）中，合并主动脉瓣反流（AR）可能导致超越瓣膜中心评估的异质性左心室（LV）重构和心肌反应。我们评估了不同AR严重程度AS患者的左心室几何结构及心肌变形与收缩压负荷的关系。方法：我们分析了950例中度或以上AS患者，分为无AR、轻度AR、中度或以上AR三组。左心室几何结构通过左心室质量指数（LVMI）和相对室壁厚度（RWT）评估。后负荷校正应变（AAS）计算为绝对左心室整体纵向应变（LVGLS）乘以估计的左心室收缩压。主要结局为全因死亡或心力衰竭住院。结果：中位随访3.5年期间，发生122例主要事件。AR严重程度增加与左心室扩张、LVMI升高及RWT降低相关，而AAS在各AR组间保持相似。左心室几何测量指标与主要结局无独立关联。较低的AAS与主要结局独立相关（每降低500单位，调整后HR 1.33，95% CI 1.12-1.58，p=0.001；每降低1个标准差，调整后HR 1.41，95% CI 1.14-1.73，p=0.001）。AAS在临床和左心室几何变量基础上提供了增量预后价值，将1年AUC从0.762提升至0.788（p<0.001）。结论：在中度或以上AS合并不同程度AR的患者中，AR严重程度增加与进行性左心室重构相关，而较低的AAS与不良结局独立相关。将心肌变形与收缩压负荷相关联，可能超越临床和左心室几何测量指标，优化风险分层。

papers.title: ChatIBD: design, safeguards, and early international use of a guideline-grounded generative AI tool for inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) professionals
papers.translated_title: ChatIBD：面向炎症性肠病（IBD）专业人员的指南驱动型生成式AI工具的设计、保障措施及早期国际应用
papers.author: Chuah, C. S.
papers.summary: Objectives To describe the design, operational safeguards, and early use of ChatIBD, a specialty-specific generative AI platform for inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), during its first 6 months of live deployment. Methods ChatIBD is an online question-answering platform that uses retrieval-augmented generation over a curated corpus of IBD guidelines. Queries undergo hybrid semantic and keyword retrieval with query expansion and reranking, and the model is instructed to answer only from retrieved material and return linked citations. Safeguards include fixed medication dosing information from European Medicines Agency (EMA), user feedback capture, and clinician review of flagged outputs. We performed a descriptive service evaluation of aggregated, de-identified platform metrics collected between 1 October 2025 and 1 April 2026. Results During the study period, ChatIBD registered 913 users and processed 7,222 messages across 3,855 conversations. Activity was recorded across 69 countries and 28 languages, with the highest message volumes from the United Kingdom (27.1%) and Spain (12.3%). Median daily message volume was 35.5 (IQR 20 to 52), and 85.1% of messages were submitted on weekdays. Medication-related queries accounted for the largest use domain, while guideline synthesis was the most frequent inferred intent. Sixteen explicit feedback events were recorded, including one negative rating that triggered clinician review and system changes. Conclusions ChatIBD showed early international uptake and repeat use as a specialty-specific, retrieval-grounded generative AI tool for IBD professionals. These findings support the feasibility of deploying a guideline-grounded clinical AI service with practical safeguards, but do not establish response accuracy, safety, or clinical effectiveness. Formal validation is in progress.
papers.translated_summary: 目的 描述ChatIBD（一款针对炎症性肠病（IBD）的专科生成式人工智能平台）在正式上线前6个月内的设计、运行保障措施及早期应用情况。方法 ChatIBD是一个在线问答平台，采用检索增强生成技术，基于经筛选的IBD指南语料库运行。查询通过混合语义与关键词检索，结合查询扩展与重排序处理，模型被限定仅依据检索材料作答并返回引用来源。保障措施包括固定用药剂量信息（源自欧洲药品管理局EMA）、用户反馈收集以及临床医生对标记输出的审核。我们对2025年10月1日至2026年4月1日期间收集的聚合、去标识化平台指标进行了描述性服务评估。结果 研究期间，ChatIBD注册用户913人，处理了3855次对话中的7222条消息。活动覆盖69个国家和28种语言，消息量最高的地区为英国（27.1%）和西班牙（12.3%）。每日消息量中位数为35.5条（四分位距20至52），85.1%的消息在工作日提交。药物相关查询占比最大，而指南综合是最常见的推断意图。共记录16次显性反馈事件，其中一次负面评价触发了临床医生审核及系统调整。结论 ChatIBD作为一款面向IBD专业人员的专科检索型生成式人工智能工具，展现了早期国际应用与重复使用特征。这些发现支持部署基于指南的临床人工智能服务并配备实用保障措施的可行性，但未验证应答准确性、安全性或临床有效性。正式验证正在进行中。

papers.title: Temporal Response and Survival Dynamics After Durvalumab in Stage III NSCLC: A Response-Augmented Continuous-Time Markov Framework
papers.translated_title: III期非小细胞肺癌患者接受度伐利尤单抗治疗后的时间响应与生存动态：一种响应增强的连续时间马尔可夫框架
papers.author: Wals Zurita, A. J.
papers.summary: Background: Immunotherapy in unresectable stage III NSCLC shows delayed treatment effects and time varying hazards that challenge proportional-hazards assumptions. We developed a continuous-time Markov chain (CTMC) model with piecewise hazards to capture the temporal dynamics of durvalumab after chemoradiotherapy (PACIFIC era), enabling transparent extrapolation beyond early trial landmarks. Methods: We specified a multi state CTMC with absorbing death, and clinically interpretable transient states (pre-progression disease control and post-progression). Piecewise transition rates were calibrated to early PACIFIC landmarks (e.g., 0, 12, 24, 36 months) for overall survival (OS) and progression free survival (PFS), using constrained optimization. External validity was assessed by comparing model-implied OS/PFS trajectories against published PACIFIC follow ups and large real world evidence. Uncertainty was quantified via parametric resampling of transition intensities and sensitivity to piecewise knots. Results: The CTMC reproduced the hallmark delayed separation of survival curves and the long-tail behavior typical of immune checkpoint inhibition. When calibrated only to early landmarks, the model generated plausible OS and PFS beyond 36 months, approaching 5 year targets reported in PACIFIC follow ups (e.g., 43% OS and 33% PFS with durvalumab), while acknowledging mild underestimation of late PFS in sensitivity scenarios. Goodness of fit remained stable across alternative knot placements; uncertainty widened beyond 60 months, as expected from non-individual data calibration. Conclusions: A piecewise-hazard CTMC provides a transparent and reproducible framework to model non-proportional, time-dependent immunotherapy effects in stage III NSCLC, reconciling early trial information with clinically coherent long term projections. This approach can support methodological rigor in survival analysis, scenario planning, and health economic extrapolation in the PACIFIC setting and similar contexts. Keywords continuous time Markov chain; non proportional hazards; immunotherapy; durvalumab; PACIFIC; stage III NSCLC; survival extrapolation.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：在不可切除的III期非小细胞肺癌免疫治疗中，存在延迟性治疗效果和随时间变化的危险因素，这对比例风险假设构成挑战。我们开发了一种具有分段危险函数的连续时间马尔可夫链模型，用于捕捉放化疗后度伐利尤单抗治疗（PACIFIC时代）的时间动态特征，从而在早期试验里程碑之外实现透明的外推。方法：我们构建了一个包含吸收态死亡和临床可解释的暂态（进展前疾病控制状态与进展后状态）的多状态连续时间马尔可夫链模型。通过约束优化，将分段转移率校准至PACIFIC早期里程碑（如0、12、24、36个月）的总生存期和无进展生存期数据。通过比较模型推导的总生存期/无进展生存期轨迹与已发表的PACIFIC随访数据及大型真实世界证据，评估外部有效性。通过参数化重采样转移强度并分析对分段节点的敏感性，量化不确定性。结果：该连续时间马尔可夫链模型再现了免疫检查点抑制治疗中典型的生存曲线延迟分离和长尾特征。当仅基于早期里程碑进行校准时，模型生成了36个月后合理的总生存期和无进展生存期预测，接近PACIFIC随访中报告的5年目标（例如度伐利尤单抗组43%的总生存期和33%的无进展生存期），同时承认在敏感性场景中晚期无进展生存期存在轻微低估。不同节点设置下的拟合优度保持稳定；60个月后不确定性扩大，这符合非个体数据校准的预期。结论：分段危险连续时间马尔可夫链模型为模拟III期非小细胞肺癌中非比例、时间依赖性免疫治疗效应提供了透明且可重复的框架，能够协调早期试验信息与临床合理的长期预测。该方法可支持PACIFIC场景及类似情境下生存分析、情景规划和卫生经济学外推的方法学严谨性。关键词：连续时间马尔可夫链；非比例风险；免疫治疗；度伐利尤单抗；PACIFIC；III期非小细胞肺癌；生存外推。

papers.title: High quality analysis of circulating biomarkers reveals no evidence of elevated inflammatory markers in a long COVID cohort recruited at a primary care center
papers.translated_title: 对初级保健中心招募的长期新冠队列进行的高质量循环生物标志物分析显示，无证据表明炎症标志物升高。
papers.author: Torres, M. L.
papers.summary: Long COVID (LC) is a broad label encompassing the heterogeneous long-term consequences of SARSCoV2 infection that persist for at least 3 months post-infection. Despite its substantial global burden, there is still a lack of reliable biomarkers or panels capable of distinguishing individuals with Long COVID from healthy individuals or from those who have recovered from acute COVID-19. We previously characterized a biomarker panel comparing 85 adults with WHO-defined Long COVID against 85 age- and sex-matched controls who had recovered within three months of acute COVID-19 in 2020, at between 12 and 24 months post-infection. That initial profile evaluated blood cell counts, coagulation status, routine SARS-CoV-2 serology, immune cell populations, and basic cytokine levels based on Luminex assays. We have enhanced our biomarker panel by incorporating more precise cytokine quantification using the high-precision ELLA automated immunoassay system. To assess potential ongoing peripheral systemic inflammation, we measured classical inflammatory markers in blood, including C-reactive protein (CRP), tumor necrosis factor alpha (TNFalpha), interleukin (IL)1beta, and IL6. In this manuscript, we present data that confirm age- and gender-matching between the LC and control group; and compared differences in cytokine levels and comorbidities.
papers.translated_summary: 长新冠（Long COVID，LC）是一个广义术语，涵盖SARS-CoV-2感染后持续至少三个月的异质性长期后果。尽管其全球负担沉重，但目前仍缺乏可靠的生物标志物或组合来区分长新冠患者与健康个体或急性COVID-19康复者。我们此前在2020年对85名符合WHO定义的长新冠成人患者与85名年龄和性别匹配的急性COVID-19三个月内康复者（感染后12至24个月）进行了生物标志物组合对比研究。该初始分析评估了血细胞计数、凝血状态、常规SARS-CoV-2血清学、免疫细胞群以及基于Luminex检测的基础细胞因子水平。我们通过采用高精度ELLA自动化免疫分析系统进行更精确的细胞因子定量，进一步优化了生物标志物组合。为评估潜在的外周系统性炎症，我们检测了血液中的经典炎症标志物，包括C反应蛋白（CRP）、肿瘤坏死因子α（TNFalpha）、白细胞介素（IL）1β和IL6。本文呈现的数据证实了长新冠组与对照组在年龄和性别上的匹配性，并比较了细胞因子水平及合并症的差异。

papers.title: In Vivo Topographic Associations Between Tau Pathology, Atrophy, and Symptom Domains in Patients with Progressive Supranuclear Palsy
papers.translated_title: 进行性核上性麻痹患者中Tau病理、萎缩与症状领域之间的体内地形关联
papers.author: Kataoka, Y.
papers.summary: Background and Objectives: Progressive supranuclear palsy (PSP) is a four-repeat tauopathy characterized by subcortical atrophy and distinctive motor impairments. Although tau pathology is thought to drive neuronal loss, the spatial relationships among tau deposition, regional atrophy, and domain-specific symptoms remain incompletely understood. We aimed to determine how the topographic distribution of tau pathology and regional brain atrophy relate to distinct motor symptom domains in PSP and to clarify their contributions to clinical manifestations. Methods: A single-center, cross-sectional study was conducted. Patients with PSP were recruited after diagnosis at neurology departments and were referred to our institution. All PSP cases underwent neurological assessments, including PSP Rating Scale. Tau positron emission tomography (PET) imaging with florzolotau (18F) and T1-weighted magnetic resonance imaging were obtained from patients and healthy controls to assess associations between domain scores, tau accumulation, and regional brain volumes. Path analysis was used to examine whether cross-sectional associations were consistent with hypothesized relationships among tau deposits, regional atrophy, and symptom domains. Results: Fifty-eight patients with PSP (mean age, 71.6 years; 43.1% female; Richardson syndrome, n = 43) and 52 healthy controls (mean age, 60.8 years; 45.3% female) were included. Subcortical tau accumulation and atrophy demonstrated significant spatial overlap and were associated with motor deficits. Ocular motor domain scores were associated with tau deposition in the midbrain tegmentum and globus pallidus. Gait and midline domain scores were associated with tau in the globus pallidus, thalamus, and subthalamic nucleus. Limb motor domain scores were associated with tau in the primary motor and somatosensory cortices, as well as atrophy in the angular, supramarginal, and temporal cortices. These findings were identified at a family-wise error corrected cluster-level threshold of p < 0.05. Path analysis indicated that tau in subcortical structures was associated with local neuronal loss and with impairments in the ocular motor and gait and midline domains. Discussion: High-contrast tau imaging clarifies the neuropathological basis of key symptoms and underscores distinct tau-induced neurotoxic effects in subcortical versus neocortical regions. Specifically, tau deposition in the neocortex may contribute to limb motor impairments through local effects and potentially through more distributed neurodegenerative processes. These findings support anatomically distinct tau-neurodegeneration pathways underlying key PSP symptom domains.
papers.translated_summary: 背景与目的：进行性核上性麻痹（PSP）是一种以皮层下萎缩和特征性运动障碍为表现的四重复Tau蛋白病。尽管Tau病理被认为驱动神经元丢失，但Tau沉积、区域萎缩与特定症状域之间的空间关系仍未完全阐明。本研究旨在明确PSP中Tau病理的拓扑分布与区域性脑萎缩如何关联不同运动症状域，并阐明其对临床表现的贡献。方法：开展单中心横断面研究。经神经内科诊断后转诊至本院的PSP患者被纳入研究。所有PSP病例均接受神经系统评估（包括PSP评定量表）。对患者及健康对照进行florzolotau（18F）Tau正电子发射断层扫描（PET）及T1加权磁共振成像，以评估症状域评分、Tau蓄积与区域脑体积之间的关联。采用路径分析检验横断面关联是否与Tau沉积、区域萎缩及症状域间的假设关系一致。结果：纳入58例PSP患者（平均年龄71.6岁，女性43.1%；Richardson综合征43例）及52例健康对照（平均年龄60.8岁，女性45.3%）。皮层下Tau蓄积与萎缩呈现显著空间重叠，并与运动功能障碍相关。眼动症状域评分与中脑被盖及苍白球Tau沉积相关；步态及中线症状域评分与苍白球、丘脑及丘脑底核Tau沉积相关；肢体运动症状域评分与初级运动及体感皮层Tau沉积相关，同时与角回、缘上回及颞叶皮层萎缩相关。上述结果在家族误差校正簇水平阈值p<0.05时具有统计学意义。路径分析显示，皮层下结构Tau沉积与局部神经元丢失及眼动、步态中线症状域损害相关。讨论：高对比度Tau成像阐明了关键症状的神经病理基础，并揭示了皮层下与新皮层区域Tau诱导神经毒性效应的差异。具体而言，新皮层Tau沉积可能通过局部效应及更广泛的神经退行性过程导致肢体运动障碍。这些发现支持PSP主要症状域背后存在解剖学上独立的Tau-神经退行性通路。

papers.title: Associations of family adversity and childhood trauma with multidomain psychopathology in adolescent depression
papers.translated_title: 家庭逆境和童年创伤与青少年抑郁症多领域精神病理学的关联
papers.author: Wang, P.
papers.summary: Background: Adolescent major depressive disorder (MDD) is heterogeneous, with diverse and frequently co-occurring psychopathological manifestations. Although family-related experiences, childhood trauma, rumination, and psychological resilience have each been linked to adolescent mental health, less is known about how they are interrelated and jointly associated with distinct psychopathological domains. This study examined these associations within an integrative framework. Methods: This cross-sectional study included 80 adolescents with MDD and 53 healthy controls. Family functioning, parenting, childhood trauma, rumination, psychological resilience, and four clinical domains, including affective distress, suicidal ideation, the non-suicidal self-injury (NSSI) spectrum, and self-regulation difficulties, were assessed using validated instruments. Partial least squares structural equation modeling (PLS-SEM) examined their multivariate associations. Sensitivity analyses restricted to the MDD sample and covariate-adjusted regression models assessed the robustness of the findings. Results: The four clinical domains showed high reliability and acceptable discriminant validity. Family dysfunction was associated with maladaptive parenting and childhood trauma, and maladaptive parenting was associated with childhood trauma (beta = .383-.600; all p < .001). Childhood trauma was associated with greater rumination (beta = .625) and lower psychological resilience (beta = -.405; both p < .001). Rumination and psychological resilience showed opposing associations with all four domains (rumination: beta = .280-.559; resilience: beta = -.265 to -.399; all p <= .006). Family dysfunction, maladaptive parenting, and childhood trauma showed significant total indirect associations with each domain (all p < .001). The model explained 53%-85% of the variance across the four domains. The MDD-only analysis reproduced the principal associations observed in the combined sample and additionally showed direct associations between maladaptive parenting and all four clinical domains. Covariate-adjusted analyses retained all principal associations except the resilience-NSSI association. Conclusions: The findings support a multidimensional characterization of adolescent MDD comprising distinguishable yet interrelated domains of affective-psychosomatic distress, suicidal ideation, the NSSI spectrum, and self-regulation difficulties. The partly shared and partly distinct associations of these domains with family-related adversity, rumination, and psychological resilience support considering domain-level psychopathology alongside diagnostic status and global depression severity in research on adolescent MDD.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：青少年重度抑郁症（MDD）具有异质性，常伴随多样化的共病精神病理表现。尽管家庭相关经历、童年创伤、反刍思维和心理韧性均与青少年心理健康相关，但关于这些因素如何相互关联并共同影响不同精神病理领域的研究仍不充分。本研究在整合框架下探讨了这些关联。方法：本横断面研究纳入80名MDD青少年患者和53名健康对照者。采用经验证的量表评估家庭功能、教养方式、童年创伤、反刍思维、心理韧性及四个临床领域（情感困扰、自杀意念、非自杀性自伤（NSSI）谱系和自我调节困难）。通过偏最小二乘结构方程模型（PLS-SEM）分析其多变量关联，并基于MDD样本的敏感性分析及协变量校正回归模型检验结果稳健性。结果：四个临床领域显示出高信度和可接受的区分效度。家庭功能障碍与不良教养方式及童年创伤相关，不良教养方式与童年创伤相关（β=0.383-0.600；均p<0.001）。童年创伤与反刍思维增强（β=0.625）及心理韧性降低（β=-0.405；均p<0.001）相关。反刍思维和心理韧性对四个临床领域呈现相反关联（反刍思维：β=0.280-0.559；心理韧性：β=-0.265至-0.399；均p≤0.006）。家庭功能障碍、不良教养方式和童年创伤对各领域均存在显著总间接效应（均p<0.001）。模型解释了四个领域53%-85%的方差。仅MDD样本分析复现了联合样本的主要关联，并额外显示不良教养方式与所有四个临床领域的直接关联。协变量校正分析保留了除心理韧性-NSSI关联外的所有主要关联。结论：研究结果支持青少年MDD的多维度特征，包含可区分但相互关联的情感-心身困扰、自杀意念、NSSI谱系及自我调节困难领域。这些领域与家庭逆境、反刍思维和心理韧性存在部分共享及部分特异的关联，提示在青少年MDD研究中需同时考虑领域级精神病理学、诊断状态及整体抑郁严重程度。

papers.title: Structural Brain Biomarkers for Identifying Progressive Amnestic Mild Cognitive Impairment
papers.translated_title: 识别进行性遗忘型轻度认知障碍的结构性脑生物标志物
papers.author: Cherkasov, N.
papers.summary: Objective. To identify the structural features of the brain in patients with amnestic mild cognitive impairment (aMCI) compared to healthy individuals, as well as to detect structural markers of progression to dementia in aMCI subgroups with different clinical outcomes. Materials and Methods. 41 patients with aMCI (mean age 71.5{+/-}9.5 years, 33 females) who underwent clinical assessment during 1 year follow-up, and 38 healthy controls (mean age 63.7{+/-}11.7 years, 28 females) were included. MRI scans were acquired, and the cortical thickness in both hemispheres, as well as the volumes of subcortical structures and hippocampal subfields, were analyzed. Results. Patients with aMCI as a whole, as well as aMCI subgroups with different clinical outcomes, showed significantly smaller bilateral hippocampal volumes and volumes of several hippocampal subfields than healthy controls. In addition, patients who were subsequently diagnosed with Alzheimer's disease dementia exhibited lower cortical gray matter thickness and smaller bilateral amygdala volumes than the healthy controls. Several subcortical structures and hippocampal subregions remained preserved in patients with aMCI, including those with unfavorable clinical outcomes. Conclusion. The study revealed structural brain abnormalities in aMCI, characterized by reduced hippocampal and hippocampal subfield volumes, as well as amygdala volume reduction, while other subcortical structures were relatively preserved. Furthermore, reduced cortical gray matter thickness may serve as a potential prognostic marker for conversion to dementia in patients with aMCI.
papers.translated_summary: 目的：识别遗忘型轻度认知障碍（aMCI）患者与健康个体相比的脑结构特征，并检测不同临床结局的aMCI亚组中进展为痴呆的结构标志物。材料与方法：纳入41例aMCI患者（平均年龄71.5±9.5岁，女性33例）和38例健康对照者（平均年龄63.7±11.7岁，女性28例），患者接受为期1年的临床随访评估。采集MRI扫描数据，分析双侧大脑半球皮质厚度、皮层下结构体积及海马亚区体积。结果：整体aMCI患者及不同临床结局的aMCI亚组均显示双侧海马体积及多个海马亚区体积显著小于健康对照组。此外，后续诊断为阿尔茨海默病痴呆的患者较健康对照组表现出更低的皮质灰质厚度及更小的双侧杏仁核体积。aMCI患者（包括临床结局不良者）的若干皮层下结构及海马亚区保持相对完整。结论：研究揭示了aMCI患者存在以海马及海马亚区体积缩小、杏仁核体积减小为特征的结构性脑异常，而其他皮层下结构相对保留。此外，皮质灰质厚度降低可能作为aMCI患者向痴呆转化的潜在预后标志物。
